feature_contract.goal: Correct aspect-preserving original main-menu and vehicle-selection sprite matrix output when the D3DX producer supplies independently optional scaling or translation, without altering normal gameplay or existing complete-vector paths.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only original title/menu/car-select partially nullable D3DXMatrixTransformation2D producer vectors and deterministic source-matrix regression; no HUD, ESC, F11, world/particles, SkyGlow, projection transport or DX11/DXVK edits.
trace_stages: Original OutRun front-end sprites issue D3DXMatrixTransformation2D with either optional scale or translation omitted, an API-legal request.
The existing UI containment hook skipped the entire aspect transform when exactly one vector is absent, forwarding anisotropic screen-space source while DrawPrimitiveUP later presents menu geometry.
Title/menu/vehicle-select partial inputs now synthesize identity defaults, stage both finite vectors, and preserve native menu proportions before R84 R33 stereo submission and host presentation.
subcomponents: Restore 4:3/16:9/21:9 and portrait XR containment for scaling-without-translation and translation-without-scaling native front-end sprite matrices.
Keep the complete-vector path unchanged and reject both-absent, invalid, desktop/gameplay HUD, GOAL, ESC, F11 and nonfinite partial inputs without exposing caller-vector mutations.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original menu and car-select D3DX matrix producer
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Either missing optional input vector retains centered uniform 4:3 content dimensions across widescreen and portrait output.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Desktop gameplay and unrelated UI producer isolation
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Both-vector original path and non-menu, nil-vector or nonfinite input use prior output semantics, with input pointers unmodified.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 Win32 main DLL and R26_SAFE rollback, x64 host, package and domain gate
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: All mandatory GitHub exact-SHA automation gates pass without CI skipping; matching Quest3 optics remain UNTESTED.

diagnosis.original_evidence: The current original D3DXMatrixTransformation2D_dest requires pScaling && pTranslation before any source-aspect correction; the D3DX API permits these pointers to be optional independently.
diagnosis.root_cause: Partial optional native menu matrix inputs skip 4:3 containment and inherit game widescreen anisotropy or off-center translation, unlike the existing two-vector path.
source_trace: menu/car-select original D3DX transform vector options
UI scaling hook staged geometry before game DrawPrimitiveUP
R84 stereo renderer and host menu plane receive the resulting transformed sprite
alternatives_rejected: Do not crop captured 21:9 car-selection content indiscriminately or stretch X/Y separately; do not broaden to GOAL/ESC/F11 gameplay.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Constrain correction to title/menu/car-select and synthesize absent identity vector before transactional aspect containment, retaining existing complete-vector path.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Targeted Python source/mutation and numerical fixtures cover two independent optional vectors, five state/guard mutations, widescreen, portrait and source defaults.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: The original 2D sprite coordinates change only before R84 physical stereo handling; exact per-eye renderer/hmd optical acceptance remains separate.
